XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: EGR valve - EGR valve pipe - Intake manifold

  • Fault: The vehicle exhibits a significant drop in performance at high speeds and the generic fault indicator is illuminated.
    The message "Engine: Repair Immediately" appears on the central instrument cluster display. Restarting the vehicle temporarily restores correct operation.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
  • P1102 (Mass air flow sensor: range/performance mismatch)
  • P2279 (Intake air leak - Detected, active)
  • Cause: EGR valve, associated piping and intake duct fouled

• Action: Check the condition of the EGR valve pipe, the valve itself and the intake manifold; clean them if necessary.
